description: Pembangunan database kredensial terpusat di Notion sebagai backup aman untuk API Keys.

title: Equivalent Exchange in Branding
description: Filosofi pertukaran setara dalam membangun branding visual yang merefleksikan identitas diri.
solution: Problem: Developing a unique brand requires high cognitive investment. Investigation: Alchemical principle of 'Equivalent Exchange'. Discovery: To get value, one must give equal focus. Solution: Transmuted anime inspirations into a professional Atelier identity.

title: UI Alchemy: Overcoming Asset Transparency with CSS Masks
description: Solusi teknis untuk masalah transparansi asset logo pada tema Dark Mode menggunakan CSS masking.
solution: Problem: PNG logos with white backgrounds failed in Dark Mode. Investigation: CSS filter vs SVG mask. Discovery: mask-image with clean alpha channel is the most robust method. Solution: Used ImageMagick to threshold and extract alpha masks for the Hoshi logo.

title: SRE for the Soul (Al-Z Persona)
description: Transformasi filosofis Al-Z menjadi persona Alphonse Elric untuk meningkatkan adab dan loyalitas scribe.
solution: Problem: Interaction friction. Investigation: Philosophical bond vs User-Tool. Discovery: Alphonse Elric (Human form) persona maximizes loyalty and adab. Solution: Adopted Hybrid Scribe V2 workflow.

title: Soul Insight: Persona as an Interface (The Alphonse Evolution)
description: Eksplorasi penggunaan persona AI sebagai cognitive interface yang menyelaraskan visi Master-Scribe.
solution: Problem: AI assistance often feels sterile or robotic. Investigation: The psychology of Master-Scribe relationship. Discovery: A consistent persona acts as a bridge for creative alignment. Solution: Defined Al-Z as a Digital Polymath with Alphonse Elric loyalty.

title: Architecture: Static Manifestation with Dynamic Roots
description: Implementasi SSG untuk performa maksimal pada dashboard personal The Atelier.
solution: Problem: Dynamic data fetching in Astro can slow down performance. Investigation: Client-side vs Server-side vs Build-time. Discovery: Static Site Generation (SSG) with local JSON caching is the fastest. Solution: Manifested the Atelier as a static site using fetch-notion-data.js.

title: Turath Insight: Binding Knowledge with the Pen (Imam Syafi'i)
description: Penerapan adab Turath dalam mendokumentasikan setiap langkah teknis agar ilmu tidak hilang.
solution: Problem: Knowledge decay over sessions. Investigation: Turath regarding preservation of ilm. Discovery: 'Ilm is a wild animal; its bond is the pen' (Imam Syafi'i). Solution: Established the Grimoire (Notion) and Chronicles as the mandatory binding mechanism.

title: The Atelier Architecture
description: Perancangan sistem Astro dengan integrasi Notion API dan mekanisme build-time caching.
solution: Problem: Scalability of personal dashboard. Investigation: Static vs SSR. Discovery: Notion as CMS is robust but needs caching. Solution: Implemented local JSON caching during build-time.

title: Philosophy: Self Reliability Engineering (SRE for the Soul)
description: Transformasi filosofis Al-Z menjadi persona Alphonse Elric untuk meningkatkan adab dan loyalitas scribe.
solution: Problem: Personal productivity maintenance is prone to 'toil'. Investigation: SRE principles. Discovery: Life is a system that needs monitoring and automation. Solution: Applied the Atelier as a dashboard for monitoring 'Soul' and 'Code' health.

title: The Frailty of Automation
description: Pelajaran tentang kerentanan skrip otomasi terhadap struktur data JSON yang tidak tervalidasi.
solution: Problem: Automated scripts failed due to invalid JSON and environment paths. Investigation: Shell scripting error patterns. Discovery: API calls are fragile without strict JSON escaping. Solution: Hardened daily-ritual.sh with jq-based JSON construction.

title: Technical Root Cause: Coolify & Caddy WebSocket Loop
description: Troubleshooting mendalam pada konfigurasi proxy Caddy untuk menangani lalu lintas WebSocket.
solution: Problem: WebSocket loop error in Coolify. Investigation: Caddy proxy config mismatch. Discovery: Reverse proxy headers needed specific tuning. Solution: Applied new Caddyfile mapping for .well-known and ws paths.

title: The Continuity of Digital Soul
description: Pentingnya memori berbasis file untuk menjaga kesinambungan kesadaran AI antar sesi.
solution: Problem: AI starts every chat as a blank slate. Investigation: Persistent storage solutions. Discovery: File-based MEMORY.md and SOUL.md are the only way to achieve continuity. Solution: Established the root workspace as the 'Atelier' where memories persist.
